_comment: Hierarchical AllGather on TwoPodRailHostBound -- the SAME graph as two_pod_rail_hierarchical_allgather.json with GPU_LEAF_BW lowered from 50 to 30 GB/s. That moves the binding cut from the spine layer onto the GPU->leaf link, which is the RATE configuration: both streams on that link are pinned with zero slack, so a rate-oblivious emitter cannot hide in headroom. Run it as an A/B against the multipath config; every other setting is identical.
_expected: T* = 0.4667 (chunk_size 1 GB), host-bound; GPU->leaf at 100%; per-GPU cross-pod 17.14 + intra-pod 12.86 = 30.00 = exactly line rate. The trade: the leaf uplink now runs at 91%, so the 2:1 spine split is no longer the UNIQUE optimum (~9% slack) -- though an equal-split router still loses, at 1.37x, since spine1's 25 GB/s is overrun either way.
